newsitem.title: FRANCE: French customs seize ecstasy at Channel Tunnel.
newsitem.headline: French customs seize ecstasy at Channel Tunnel.

text.p: French customs have seized 15,500 tablets of the illegal drug ecstasy aboard a lorry in the Channel Tunnel area on its way to Britain, the customs service said on Wednesday.
The driver of the lorry, a Briton who was not immediately identified, was detained during the seizure which took place on Saturday, a customs statement said.
The haul, which also included 10 kg (22 lbs) of hashish, had been loaded aboard the lorry in the Netherlands, the statement added.
The statement did not make clear if the seizure took place inside the tunnel or at its entrance.
